description: Recommended configuration profiles. Pick one as the row config; every key is optional and falls back to the plugin default.

observe.title: Observe only
observe.detail: Record everything, inject nothing, never speak on its own. The safest first step: run for a week, then read the health report.

private-memory.title: Private chat memory
private-memory.detail: Remember and inject in one-to-one chats only. Direct messages always wake, so no probability tuning is needed.

group-selectivity.title: Group with selective waking
group-selectivity.detail: Ambient group chatter only reaches the model when a topic matches attention, or when the exploration roll passes. Expect roughly one spontaneous reply per ten relevant messages until attention grows.
